therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced T-cell proliferation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Locally advanced stage IIIA/B non-small cell lung cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Grade ≥3 pneumonitis up to 6 months post-radiotherapy

results.effect_size: 71 participants completed 6 months post-radiotherapy without grade ≥3 pneumonitis
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included neutropenia, fever, nausea, colitis, esophageal fistula, sepsis

context.duration: Treatment through chemoradiotherapy completion, follow-up up to 4 years
